== The Road to Oz ==

Polly travels with Dorothy, Button-Bright, and the shaggy man on the road toward Oz. Dorothy addresses her as the Rainbow's Daughter and asks whether she can work magic, but Polly answers plainly, "No, dear," even after Dorothy suggests she ought to know some, given that heritage. Dorothy speaks warmly of her, thanking her for an offer to dance upon the rainbows they encounter, though Dorothy declines, worried the rainbows would prove soft and squnshy underfoot. When Johnny Dooit rigs a sail from rope and canvas, Polly watches the work take shape with the same absorbed interest as Button-Bright.
</div>
